4. I said __________________________________________________ a wash room as well. ('I am hungry. I need...')
5. Another woman from my back said _________________________________ for her connecting bus. ('I'll be late')
6. Some children cried that _______________________________ outside. ('We are fed up and want to go')
7. A senior citizen said ____________________________________. ('My pressure is rising up')
8. The driver said that ____________________________________________________________________ last week too. ('I'm so sorry but the same thing happened')
Suppose last year you met a friend of yours, Mathin, after many years. These are some information about Mathin that she herself gave you.
